name: mage-book-pdf-render
description: Node-only tooling for the MAGE book PDF print edition. NOT part of the stdlib-only catalog.py / site build — used by `build_book_html.py` to render ```mermaid fences to inline SVG at BUILD time (mermaid-cli / mmdc) and by `--pdf` to render book/mage-book.pdf via Paged.js + Puppeteer. The web book build stays dependency-free EXCEPT for the mermaid-cli SVG pre-render (guarded: a page with no mermaid fence needs no Node).
